notes.subject: sekelu
notes.rationale: כסף kɔrɔ ye warigwɛ ye; jateden na, 'sekelu' (sariya minɛko daɲɛ) farala a kan — Heburukan ma a fɔ.

notes.subject: יצאו
notes.rationale: jateden kɔrɔko (agent) ma klarite: Solomon ka nafamabagaw walima Aram ka masakɛw yɛrɛ? Bambara bɛ 'u' jɔ, wh o kɔrɔ ma klarite.

notes.subject: jatedenw
notes.rationale: marike: warigwɛ 600; sɔ: warigwɛ 150 — sanidi jateden ye.

notes.subject: ותעלה ותצא
notes.rationale: Kuman #2: marike tun bɛ se ka minɛ ka bɔ Misira ni warigwɛ 600 ye (habitable import, i n'a fɔ BSB) — waasira 'kaa taa ka bɔ' tun na ɲɛ.

translation: Marike (sigi-marike) min bɛ taa ka bɔ Mitsrayim (Misira), o tun ye warigwɛ sekelu ayi-wolonwula ye, ni sɔ bɔrɔ dɔ ye warigwɛ sekelu ɲɔgɔn-fila-ni-ɔɔ-duru ye; cogo kelen na, u y'u faa masakɛw bɛɛ ma — Hitiw ka masakɛw ni Aram (Siri) ka masakɛw — ni u bolo nɔgɔya ye.

tokens.gloss: ka taa sanfɛ (bɔ yɔrɔ dɔ la)
